import re
import sys


def main():
    text = sys.stdin.read()
    paragraphs = [p.strip() for p in text.split('\n\n') if p.strip()]
    paragraphs_count = len(paragraphs)
    
    sentences = []
    current_sentence = []
    in_sentence = False
    for line in text.split('\n'):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        if not in_sentence:
            current_sentence = []
            in_sentence = True
        for word in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9'-]+", line):
            current_sentence.append(word)
        if current_sentence:
            terminators = re.findall(r"[.!?]+", line)
            for terminator in terminators:
                if terminator == "." and line.startswith((".Mr", ".Mrs", ".Dr", ".St"), case=False):
                    continue
                sentences.append(" ".join(current_sentence))
                current_sentence = []
                in_sentence = False
    if current_sentence:
        sentences.append(" ".join(current_sentence))
    sentences_count = len([s for s in sentences if s.strip()])
    
    words = []
    for sentence in sentences:
        words.extend(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9'-]+", sentence))
    words_count = len(words)
    longest_word = max(words, key=len) if words else "-"
    
    print("paragraphs", paragraphs_count)
    print("sentences", sentences_count)
    print("words", words_count)
    print("longest", longest_word)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
